message.content: The case concerns whether the dispatcher can release the amended loading summary for container C74. The crane lift log (S1) strongly supports that C74 was lifted at 06:25, confirming claim B. The container register (S2) contradicts claim C, showing C74 is a high-cube container, not standard height. Claim A about passing the dockside seal integrity check remains unresolved: while an upstream inspection (S3) noted an intact seal on arrival and a rough lift before the dockside check, it does not explicitly confirm that C74 passed the dockside seal integrity check. This unresolved status on seal integrity is the key issue affecting the decision to release the amended loading summary.
